root_cause.text: The `accel/amdxdna` driver performs a `memset` to clear the `npu_slot` buffer before validating whether the remaining buffer size (`*size`) is large enough to accommodate the command slot header.
root_cause.evidence: In `drivers/accel/amdxdna/aie2_message.c`, the patch moves the `memset(npu_slot, 0, sizeof(*npu_slot))` call in functions like `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_cf` to execute only after the size validation check `if (*size < sizeof(*npu_slot) + cmd_len)` succeeds.
